narrative.overview: AgentDeck renders as a terminal-native operator console: a near-black, cool-tinted field where a fleet's state reads like well-kept instrumentation. Everything is set in one monospaced family; hierarchy comes from weight, size, and tonal steps, never from ornament. One electric cyan is the only voice the interface itself speaks — every other color belongs to the work (running, accepted, failed, tooling). The layout serves a side-monitor glance: a slim left rail for navigation, full-width working views, and a board readable in two seconds.
keyCharacteristics: Mono-forward: one typeface, five roles, fixed rem scale
Tonal depth: hairlines and surface steps, zero decorative shadows
One accent (Signal Cyan ≤10% of any screen); state colors mean states
Dark canonical, daylight variant for bright rooms
Dense but breathable: 1.55 body line-height, 4/8/12/16/24 spacing rhythm

rules.name: The One Phosphor Rule
rules.body: Signal Cyan appears on at most 10% of any screen: primary action, current selection, focus. If cyan is decorating something, it is wrong.

rules.name: The State Speaks Rule
rules.body: Amber, emerald, red, and indigo are forbidden outside their semantic meanings. A color the operator can't parse as a state is noise.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 and 600 only. If hierarchy needs more, fix the size or the color layer, not the weight.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No second typeface, ever. A sans sneaking into a dialog is a regression.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If an edge needs marking, it gets a 1px Hairline — not a shadow, not a thicker border, not a side-stripe.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Shadows are prohibited. An element that 'needs' a shadow needs a tonal step instead. Audit test: if any box-shadow other than the focus ring ships, it's a defect.

dos: Do hold the One Phosphor Rule: Signal Cyan (#37d2f2) only for primary action, selection, and focus — ≤10% of any screen.
Do floor informational text at Phosphor Muted (#a2adb3) on dark and Daylight Muted (#4e575d) on light; 4.5:1 is the contract.
Do build depth from tonal steps (#070b0d → #101518 → #191f23) and 1px Hairlines.
Do keep every number in tabular-nums — live-updating digits must not jitter.
Do give every interactive element default, hover, focus-visible, and disabled states, and every animation a reduced-motion alternative.
donts: Don't ship CI/CD console gloom: no wall-of-widgets, no log-soup without hierarchy; density must stay legible.
Don't ship chat-app cuteness: no agent avatars, no emoji status, no anthropomorphizing copy.
Don't ship kanban-tool sprawl: no swimlanes, label taxonomies, or settings creep on the board.
Don't use box-shadows, gradient text, glassmorphism, side-stripe borders, or terminal cosplay (scanlines, phosphor glow, CRT curvature).
Don't use state colors decoratively, introduce a second typeface, or exceed weights 400/600.
Don't let cyan and a generic blue 'info' state coexist — indigo covers tooling; there is no info blue.
